caption: The drawing features a geometric, checkerboard-like pattern composed of intersecting horizontal and vertical bands in shades of orange and dark brown. The pattern creates alternating square and rectangular segments across the entire surface. The color palette consists of a reddish-orange and a near-black brown, both used in various widths of lines to form a grid. The grid is regularly spaced and symmetrical, with broader blocks of solid color bordered by thinner stripes, leading to a repetitive sequence of squares and rectangles of different sizes. In multiple areas where the lines cross, smaller checkerboard motifs are formed. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white, contrasting with the vivid, warm colors of the main design. There are no other distinct objects present.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
